hero.headline: UAV Technology
hero.title: Aerial Drones
hero.description:
Whether you're a government agency, an NGO, or a private developer, Smartgrid Surveying is your trusted partner! Our drones deliver actionable data where it matters most.

 Drones have transformed the surveying industry and we're leading the way. Smartgrid Surveying leverages aerial drones for mapping, 3D modeling, volumetrics, environmental assessments, and monitoring large or inaccessible areas. Beyond technical mapping, we offer professional drone photography for real estate, construction marketing, tourism, and events. Using drones equipped with RTK GPS and high-resolution sensors, we capture precise geospatial data that empowers engineers, developers, governments, and NGOs to make smarter decisions, faster. We deliver fast, accurate, and detailed surveys

services.headline: Our Aerial Surveying Services
services.description: Discover our full range of aerial drone surveying services and deliverables.

items.title: Aerial Mapping
items.description: Accurate drone-based imagery for planning, documentation, and analysis.
items.popupContent: SmartGrid Surveying delivers ultra-precise aerial mapping using UAVs to generate georeferenced orthomosaics, topographic data, and planning-grade base maps. Our solutions support infrastructure, utilities, and land development with unmatched speed and accuracy.

items.title: Construction Monitoring
items.description: Track site activity using consistent, real-time aerial visuals.
items.popupContent: SmartGrid offers site monitoring through high-resolution drone flyovers. Our automated flights provide weekly visual updates, detect deviations from schedule, and support decision-making for project managers and developers.

items.title: Environmental Monitoring
items.description: Visualize ecological change and monitor conservation areas.
items.popupContent: Using UAVs, SmartGrid tracks land cover change, deforestation, erosion, and other ecological indicators. Our data supports impact assessments and regulatory compliance with repeatable, time-stamped visuals.

items.title: Agricultural Mapping
items.description: Drone-based multispectral data for crop health and farm optimization.
items.popupContent: SmartGrid empowers agronomists with data on crop health, plant stress, and irrigation patterns. We use NDVI and multispectral analysis to optimize input use and improve yield sustainability.

items.title: 3D Modeling
items.description: Photorealistic 3D models to support planning and inspections.
items.popupContent: We create detailed 3D mesh and textured models of terrain, buildings, and infrastructure. These models are BIM-ready and useful for design validation, inspection, and immersive planning.

items.title: Infrastructure Planning
items.description: Route and terrain data for smart infrastructure layout.
items.popupContent: We map routes and sites using drone LiDAR and photogrammetry. This ensures smart siting of roads, pipelines, and urban developments while minimizing environmental disruption.

items.title: DTMs & DEMs
items.description: Digital terrain and elevation models for hydrological and civil works.
items.popupContent: Our terrain and elevation models help civil engineers and hydrologists analyze runoff, slope stability, and grading. We deliver precise elevation data to support resilient infrastructure.

items.title: Volumetric Calculations
items.description: Calculate material volumes and manage resources accurately.
items.popupContent: SmartGrid computes cut/fill volumes and stockpile measurements with centimeter-level accuracy. Our aerial photogrammetry offers fast, safe, and repeatable results.

items.title: Disaster Assessment
items.description: Route and terrain data for smart infrastructure layout.
items.popupContent: After floods, landslides, or earthquakes, SmartGrid uses drones to quickly document damage. Our data helps responders prioritize actions, allocate aid, and plan recovery operations.

droneFleet.headline: Our Drone Fleet
droneFleet.description: At SmartGrid Surveying, we deploy advanced drones to capture high-resolution aerial imagery and multispectral data for accurate mapping, monitoring, and surveying.

whyAerialSurveyDronesMatter.headline: Why Aerial Survey Drones Matter?
whyAerialSurveyDronesMatter.description: Our drone solutions deliver critical insights across multiple sectors, transforming how projects are planned, managed, and monitored.

items.title: Detailed Mapping
items.description: We use LiDAR-equipped drones to generate precise 3D, topographic, and land use maps—capturing insights at a scale and clarity beyond traditional methods. This high-resolution data enhances planning, design, and decision-making across large project areas.

items.title: Environmental Monitoring
items.description: Our drone-based surveys monitor environmental changes like vegetation loss, water shifts, and land degradation—providing critical insights for sustainability and compliance. This aerial perspective supports climate tracking, impact assessments, and proactive resource management.

items.title: Resource Management
items.description: Our aerial drone surveys support efficient resource management by monitoring forests, water bodies, and land use patterns. This data-driven approach helps identify areas needing conservation or optimized utilization.

items.title: Precision Agriculture
items.description: We use drone-based multispectral imaging to monitor crop health, soil variability, and irrigation efficiency. This empowers farmers with actionable data for precision agriculture, leading to optimized yields and reduced input costs.

items.title: Construction Planning
items.description: Our aerial surveys deliver a high-level view of terrain, infrastructure, and environment—essential for accurate site selection and feasibility analysis. This data streamlines planning for urban development, transport networks, and effective land use.

items.title: Environmental Impact Assessment
items.description: We use drone surveys to conduct precise Environmental Impact Assessments—capturing data on land cover, habitats, and ecological changes in real time. This allows for smarter project planning with minimal disruption to natural environments.

items.title: Infrastructure Management
items.description: Our drones capture high-resolution imagery and LiDAR data to assess the condition of construction sites, assets, power lines, substations, roadways, and utility corridors. This enables detailed infrastructure audits, early detection of wear or damage, and data-driven asset management planning.

items.title: Disaster Mapping
items.description: SmartGrid Surveying deploys drones rapidly after disasters to capture real-time imagery and 3D maps of affected areas. This enables emergency teams to assess damage, plan safe access routes, and prioritize relief efforts with precision.

projects.headline: PROJECTS DONE ACROSS AFRICA
projects.description: We’ve completed aerial drone surveys across several African countries, supporting governments, private developers, and NGOs. Here are a few highlights:
items: Kenya – 2,000 ha for agricultural zoning in Uasin Gishu
Ghana – 3,500 ha for cocoa plantation mapping in Kumasi
Rwanda – 1,800 ha of wetland analysis in Bugesera
South Africa – 5,200 ha for mining volumetrics in Limpopo
Nigeria – 4,100 ha urban sprawl monitoring in Abuja
East Africa Region – Over 10,000 ha surveyed across regional infrastructure and land use planning projects in Kenya, Uganda, and Tanzania
